name: Corrosion monitoring and chemical inhibition
principle: Corrosion risk is managed with a sensing-plus-chemistry loop: coupons and electrical-resistance/linear-polarisation probes give a continuous or periodic corrosion rate alongside UT wall-thickness trending at critical points; the measured environment (water cut, CO2/H2S partial pressure, temperature, flow regime) selects inhibitor chemistry — film-forming amines for condensate and overhead service, imidazolines and phosphate esters for wet gas — injected continuously or batch-wise, with residuals monitored so dose tracks the actual risk rather than a fixed schedule.

process_steps.name: Coupons and ER/LPR probes read the actual corrosion rate in the stream
UT thickness surveys trend remaining wall at critical locations
Inhibitor selected and dosed from environment and monitored residuals
Dose adjusted on the measured rate; failures trigger material upgrades

sources.note: ISO/TC 67 corrosion management standards context, read 2026-11-08
